data.name: Anaya
data.gender_notes: Anaya is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ع-ن-ي (ʿ-n-y), 'to concern, care for'. ʿInāya means 'care, protection'. Its root is ع-ن-ي (ʿ-n-y). A classical Arabic female name. Anaya is a Arabic name meaning “Care; protection; concern”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Anaya expresses “Care; protection; concern”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ع-ن-ي (ʿ-n-y), 'to concern, care for'. ʿInāya means 'care, protection'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Anaya total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.
